titulo: Woman’s body found in stockyard trough close to NSW-Queensland border
cuerpo: Police say body found by trail bike riders at remote farm in Terragon is badly decomposed, sparking search of missing persons records Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A partially submerged body believed to be a woman has been discovered in a remote stockyard, with the death being treated as suspicious. Officers were called to a property in Terragon, near Murwillumbah in northern NSW , at about 11.20am on Monday after reports of a dead body. Continue reading...
